title: UI Text Fix
description: Pause menu buttons and version sign now render their text using an OS-provided font.

title: Pause Menu
description: Press ESC in game for a pause menu with RESUME and QUIT. Menu items configurable on the component.

title: Magenta Shaders Fixed
description: All materials resolve to the built-in Standard shader; ground and props render with prototype textures.

title: Shader Fix
description: Build pipeline no longer strips shader compilation; all materials render correctly.

title: Material Fix
description: GridGround and GizmoBox now render with the prototype materials instead of the magenta error shader.

title: v2.1.2 Prerelease
description: Exercises the prerelease flag end to end: release, Pages metadata and launcher Update flow.

title: Demo Content Update
description: The game scene now shows ground, spinning props and an in-game version sign instead of a black screen.

title: UnityMultiplayer E2E
description: First release built and published from the UnityMultiplayer project through the Game Launcher Publisher package.

title: Unity Package Pipeline
description: Published automatically by com.gamelauncher.publisher during the end-to-end test.

title: Registry-Aware Versioning
description: Game now writes its version to Windows registry on startup. The launcher reads the registry key for instant version detection without parsing executables. Improved update pipeline reliability.

title: New Survival Mode
description: Added an endless survival mode with procedurally generated waves. Leaderboards integrated with the online scoring system.

title: Initial Release
description: The game launches with campaign mode, 5 levels, and online multiplayer support. Enjoy the journey!
